newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 7.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Profits of 16 national banks in UAE surged to 2.29 billion dirhams at end of 1996 from 1.95 billion the previous year, study by Emirates Industrial Bank shows.
- UAE's bank assets grew to 193 billion dirhams at end of 1996 from 181 billion at end of 1995 - Emirates Industrial Bank study.
- Bahrain's stock market index gained 67 points in June, ending month at 1,684.01.
- Emirates voted best Middle Eastern airline.
- UAE debating draft law that would raise minimum capital for banks in UAE to 100 million dirhams from current 40 million.
